title: Nanoscale Mapping of Strain and Grain Orientation in Polycrystalline Materials using a Novel Scanning Precession Electron Diffraction Method
content: Nanostructured semiconducting materials display unique mechanical and electrical properties, and are widely used for state-of-the-art microelectronic components. Crystallographic details, such as strain and orientation of nanoscale grains in the materials, have been shown to affect their electrical properties. Thus, it is crucial to characterize these parameters in order to understand and improve material performances for future devices [1].
